CVE-2025-54121.reason: Local-only API has no multipart/form endpoint; public Streamlit explicitly uses Tornado.

CVE-2025-62727.reason: Local-only API has no FileResponse or StaticFiles routes; public Streamlit explicitly uses Tornado.

CVE-2026-48710.reason: Local-only API makes no security decision using reconstructed request URLs.

CVE-2026-48817.reason: Local-only API registers no unconstrained HTTPEndpoint subclass.

CVE-2026-48818.reason: Local-only API has no Windows StaticFiles endpoint; public Streamlit explicitly uses Tornado.

CVE-2026-54282.reason: Local-only API has no hostname/URL-based security middleware.

CVE-2026-54283.reason: Local-only API does not call request.form(); public Streamlit explicitly uses Tornado.

CVE-2026-112895.reason: No PDF append or PdfParser calls in application or Streamlit 1.55.0; temporary compatibility exception. See security/pillow-review-2026-10-21.md.

CVE-2026-112400.reason: No GIF seek/recovery after DecompressionBombError in application or Streamlit 1.55.0; current text/JSON flows do not decode images. See security/pillow-review-2026-10-21.md.

CVE-2026-112397.reason: No ImageMorph operations in application or Streamlit 1.55.0; opening alone is insufficient to trigger this CVE. See security/pillow-review-2026-10-21.md.

CVE-2026-112896.reason: No TIFF encoding in application; Streamlit 1.55.0 image conversion writes JPEG/PNG/GIF, not TIFF. See security/pillow-review-2026-10-21.md.

CVE-2026-112897.reason: Current app consumes text/JSON only; traced Tornado uploads store bytes and media routes return bytes without Pillow decoding. TIFF decoding remains dangerous if image features are added. See security/pillow-review-2026-10-21.md.

CVE-2026-112395.reason: No path found from current app inputs or traced Tornado upload/media routes to TIFF pixel decoding; Streamlit image conversion could expose it if enabled. See security/pillow-review-2026-10-21.md.

CVE-2026-112404.reason: No path found from current app inputs or traced Tornado upload/media routes to TIFF pixel decoding; malformed TIFFs can leak memory if passed to Streamlit image conversion. See security/pillow-review-2026-10-21.md.

CVE-2026-112899.reason: No EPS load(scale>1) calls in application or Streamlit 1.55.0; current text/JSON flows do not render EPS. See security/pillow-review-2026-10-21.md.
